The '''46th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[1988 in film|film]] and [[1988 in American television|television]] for 1988, were held on January 28, 1989, at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]] and was televised in the [[United States]] by [[TBS (American TV network)|SuperStation TBS]]. This marked the first time the awards show aired exclusively on cable after six years on [[broadcast syndication]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globes Honor 'Working Girl,' 'War' Series|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1989-01-29-mn-2019-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=29 January 1989}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title='Working Girl' Receives 4 Golden Globe Awards|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1989/01/30/arts/working-girl-receives-4-golden-globe-awards.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=30 January 1989}}</ref> The nominations were announced on January 4, 1989.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Voland|first1=John|title='Working Girl', 'L.A. Law' Top Globe Choices|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1989-01-05-ca-272-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=5 January 1989}}</ref>
